question: What is included in the service desk?
html:
What our service desk includes

Our service desk supports law firms. Today it is built around HELIX, and over months 0-12 of the growth plan we are turning HELIX into a product-led service desk with a Tier-0 AI agent as the first line (Frontline growth plan). Our source material does not give a full list of what the desk covers today.

Delivery

  • Support is delivered from national US reach plus offshore centers in Goa, Hyderabad and Cape Town (Frontline public filings).
  • We serve 900+ law-firm clients, including about half the AM Law 200 (Frontline growth plan).
  • Staff numbered about 1,100 in January 2026 (Frontline public filings).

What changes in year one

ElementStatusSource
HELIX service deskBeing made product-ledFrontline growth plan
Tier-0 AI agentAdded as a first line before human agentsFrontline growth plan
Cyber-posture subscriptionPlanned add-onFrontline growth plan
Legal-AI enablementPlanned add-on for AM Law clientsFrontline growth plan
  • Legal-AI enablement targets a clear gap. ILTA finds 68% of firms have Copilot, but only 8% have deployed it firm-wide (Frontline growth plan).
  • From month 6, we plan to offer the desk to mid-size firms. Our 16-metro screen covers 143 firms, and 37 of them score 65+ (Mid-size law firms). For top-ranked firms, the recommended offer is a "bundle." The data does not define what that bundle contains.

What we cannot confirm yet

We cannot yet answer these questions:

  • Ticket scope. Our sources do not list ticket types, hours of coverage or tiers.
  • Pricing. Our sources give no pricing model.
  • Service levels. Our sources give no response-time commitments.
  • Deflection rate. Our sources do not show how many requests the AI agent will resolve on its own.

To answer them, we would need the HELIX service catalogue, client contract schedules and ticket-volume data by category.

The plan models EBITDA margin rising from about 15.4% (est.) to about 16.7% (est.) by month 12, partly through Tier-0 deflection and cyber attach. With roughly $90M of term debt behind the deal, this desk is one of the main ways EBITDA growth carries the return (Frontline growth plan; Frontline public filings).

Next actions

  1. Pull the current HELIX service catalogue and ticket data by category. Use them to define in-scope services and set a baseline deflection target.
  2. Write down what the mid-size "bundle" contains, including service desk, cyber-posture subscription and legal-AI enablement, before Phase 2 outreach begins.
  3. Set service levels and pricing for the Tier-0 tier. Track deflection against the margin assumptions in the growth plan.
markdown:
# What our service desk includes

Our service desk supports law firms. Today it is built around HELIX, and over months 0-12 of the growth plan we are turning HELIX into a product-led service desk with a Tier-0 AI agent as the first line (Frontline growth plan). Our source material does not give a full list of what the desk covers today.

## Delivery

- Support is delivered from national US reach plus offshore centers in Goa, Hyderabad and Cape Town (Frontline public filings).
- We serve 900+ law-firm clients, including about half the AM Law 200 (Frontline growth plan).
- Staff numbered about 1,100 in January 2026 (Frontline public filings).

## What changes in year one

| Element | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|
| HELIX service desk | Being made product-led | Frontline growth plan |
| Tier-0 AI agent | Added as a first line before human agents | Frontline growth plan |
| Cyber-posture subscription | Planned add-on | Frontline growth plan |
| Legal-AI enablement | Planned add-on for AM Law clients | Frontline growth plan |

- Legal-AI enablement targets a clear gap. ILTA finds 68% of firms have Copilot, but only 8% have deployed it firm-wide (Frontline growth plan).
- From month 6, we plan to offer the desk to mid-size firms. Our 16-metro screen covers 143 firms, and 37 of them score 65+ (Mid-size law firms). For top-ranked firms, the recommended offer is a "bundle." The data does not define what that bundle contains.

## What we cannot confirm yet

We cannot yet answer these questions:

- **Ticket scope.** Our sources do not list ticket types, hours of coverage or tiers.
- **Pricing.** Our sources give no pricing model.
- **Service levels.** Our sources give no response-time commitments.
- **Deflection rate.** Our sources do not show how many requests the AI agent will resolve on its own.

To answer them, we would need the HELIX service catalogue, client contract schedules and ticket-volume data by category.

The plan models EBITDA margin rising from about 15.4% (est.) to about 16.7% (est.) by month 12, partly through Tier-0 deflection and cyber attach. With roughly $90M of term debt behind the deal, this desk is one of the main ways EBITDA growth carries the return (Frontline growth plan; Frontline public filings).

## Next actions

1. Pull the current HELIX service catalogue and ticket data by category. Use them to define in-scope services and set a baseline deflection target.
2. Write down what the mid-size "bundle" contains, including service desk, cyber-posture subscription and legal-AI enablement, before Phase 2 outreach begins.
3. Set service levels and pricing for the Tier-0 tier. Track deflection against the margin assumptions in the growth plan.
